task_nodes.instruction: Apply RULE_R1 to Point A using given side length. Save the output to Point B. Apply RULE_R2 to Point A using given side length. Save the output to Point D. Apply RULE_R3 using outputs from Task 1.1 and Task 1.2. Save output to Point C.
task_nodes.description:
[INTENT]: Derive points B, C, and D from the origin point and side length.

[DEFERRED LOGIC]:
- Apply RULE_R1 to origin point (0,0) with side length 4 to get Point B.
- Apply RULE_R2 to origin point (0,0) with side length 4 to get Point D.
- Apply RULE_R3 to Point B and Point D to get Point C.

[SHELL ARCHITECTURE]:
- Shell: [Point_B] | Type: named shell | Content: point coordinates (row, col) | Consumer: Line Derivation Phase.
- Shell: [Point_C] | Type: named shell | Content: point coordinates (row, col) | Consumer: Line Derivation Phase.
- Shell: [Point_D] | Type: named shell | Content: point coordinates (row, col) | Consumer: Line Derivation Phase.

task_nodes.instruction: Apply RULE_CREATE_LINE to Point A and Point B. Save output to Line AB. Apply RULE_CREATE_LINE to Point B and Point C. Save output to Line BC. Apply RULE_CREATE_LINE to Point D and Point C. Save output to Line DC. Apply RULE_CREATE_LINE to Point D and Point A. Save output to Line DA.
task_nodes.description:
[INTENT]: Derive lines AB, BC, DC, and DA from points A, B, C, and D.

[DEFERRED LOGIC]:
- Apply RULE_CREATE_LINE to Point A (origin) and Point B to get Line AB.
- Apply RULE_CREATE_LINE to Point B and Point C to get Line BC.
- Apply RULE_CREATE_LINE to Point D and Point C to get Line DC.
- Apply RULE_CREATE_LINE to Point D and Point A (origin) to get Line DA.

[SHELL ARCHITECTURE]:
- Shell: [Line_AB] | Type: named shell | Content: line object with start and end points | Consumer: Line Filling Phase.
- Shell: [Line_BC] | Type: named shell | Content: line object with start and end points | Consumer: Line Filling Phase.
- Shell: [Line_DC] | Type: named shell | Content: line object with start and end points | Consumer: Line Filling Phase.
- Shell: [Line_DA] | Type: named shell | Content: line object with start and end points | Consumer: Line Filling Phase.

task_nodes.instruction: Apply RULE_R4A to Line AB. Save the List of Filled objects to a new node ID. Apply RULE_R4B to Line BC. Save the List of Filled objects to a new node ID. Apply RULE_R4A to Line DC. Save the List of Filled objects to a new node ID. Apply RULE_R4B to Line DA. Save the List of Filled objects to a new node ID.
task_nodes.description:
[INTENT]: Fill lines AB, BC, DC, and DA according to their respective rules.

[DEFERRED LOGIC]:
- Apply RULE_R4A to Line AB to fill points along the line with constant row.
- Apply RULE_R4B to Line BC to fill points along the line with constant column.
- Apply RULE_R4A to Line DC to fill points along the line with constant row.
- Apply RULE_R4B to Line DA to fill points along the line with constant column.

[SHELL ARCHITECTURE]:
- Shell: [Filled_AB] | Type: named shell | Content: list of filled point objects along Line AB | Consumer: Terminal Node.
- Shell: [Filled_BC] | Type: named shell | Content: list of filled point objects along Line BC | Consumer: Terminal Node.
- Shell: [Filled_DC] | Type: named shell | Content: list of filled point objects along Line DC | Consumer: Terminal Node.
- Shell: [Filled_DA] | Type: named shell | Content: list of filled point objects along Line DA | Consumer: Terminal Node.

task_nodes.instruction: Finalize DAG execution. Confirm all lines have been filled according to their respective rules.
task_nodes.description:
[INTENT]: Finalize the DAG execution. Graph topology identified as LINEAR — each phase depends on the output of the previous phase.

[TERMINAL_LEDGER]:
- [Filled_AB]: list of filled point objects along Line AB.
- [Filled_BC]: list of filled point objects along Line BC.
- [Filled_DC]: list of filled point objects along Line DC.
- [Filled_DA]: list of filled point objects along Line DA.

[DEPENDENCY CONFIRMATION]: Only shell IDs appear in dependencies. No task node IDs included. task_type is COMPUTE.
